name: Brave Search API
short: Brave's independent web index served as a search and grounding API for agents and RAG, with up to $20 of free calls every month and prepaid per-request pricing.

plans.name: Free monthly credits
plans.notes: Up to $20 in free calls every month; prepaid credits, no subscription. Each plan includes $5 in free credits every month, applied automatically.

plans.name: Search
plans.notes: Complete search results (URLs, text, news, images) plus an LLM-context endpoint; 50 queries/second; Goggles reranking and schema-enriched results.

plans.name: Answers
plans.notes: Summarized, citation-grounded answers over one or more searches; streaming supported.
